name: Netora Rensa ~Kimoota NEET no Oji ni Saiai no Imouto o Netorareta Ore~
original_name: ネトラレンサ～キモオタニートの叔父に最愛の妹を寝取られた俺～
source:
"Oniichan, please come home soon. If you don't..."

Takumi (you, protagonist) and his younger sister Anna lost their parents in a car crash. 
When they moved in with their uncle Hiroshi, Takumi instantly disliked him. 
For some reason Hiroshi took a liking to Anna... 
Spurred by his uncle's advances, Takumi realized that Anna was the only woman he ever wanted. 
He kissed his sister, and she, in turn... 

Takumi knew they couldn't go too far, as brother and sister. 
But that pervert Hiroshi... he had no problem crossing the line. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE136353.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
“哥哥，你快点回家吧，不然……”

拓海（你，主角）和他的妹妹安娜在一场车祸中失去了父母。
当他们搬去和叔叔弘一起住时，拓海立刻就不喜欢他了。
出于某种原因，弘喜欢上了安娜…… 
在叔叔的求爱的刺激下，拓海意识到安娜是他唯一想要的女人。
他亲吻了他的妹妹，而她也反过来…… 

拓海知道，作为兄妹，他们不能走得太远。
但那个变态宏……他跨界没有问题。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE136353.html]DLsite English[/url]]
